evidence_required: the role of the TCP MSS; the direction(s) in which large frames are lost.

marking.criterion: TCP MSS mechanism: each side advertises an MSS from its own MTU and the peer never exceeds it, so BGP segments are ≤ 1,460 B
9216 → 1500 direction: oversize frames dropped at ingress (giants), silently
1500 → 9216 direction: packets routed out of the 1500 interface fail the egress MTU check; concludes loss in both directions

title: MTU mismatch and the eBGP session
